patch_description: The prior programs (and current one) append the *full* src→dst path to every partition for every destination, so shared trunk edges get billed once per destination per partition — wasting all the sharing the Steiner-style construction creates (insight from Gen 11/16/19). The fix: build the shared trunk once via the shortest-path Steiner heuristic, record each destination's full root-to-terminal path, and then emit edges per partition with explicit deduplication — each edge of a partition is emitted exactly once, attributed to the first destination whose path uses it. Since all destinations' paths form one tree, each partition ends up carrying exactly one copy of the whole Steiner tree instead of num_dsts overlapping copies. This directly targets the deduplication the cost_score gap implies while keeping the output format `[s, t, G[s][t]]` and the per-(dst, partition) structure intact.
